contradictions.what: Rep says we were the favourite, but the decider was Halima, who was not won over; the favourite view rests on Ben, who lacked authority.
Rep thought the load test had won it, yet Halima's only response was 'good' and she then dismissed our support as a faster queue.
Rep says we were the better platform, while the customer said it buys what happens when it's down and its questions shifted to people.
Rep says we have no on-sale plan, then says he could have built one, so the gap was partly his choice.
